结果已经明确了一半：

CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL：当前 Kconfig 整段缺失，upstream 有完整配置，因此 .config 无法生成该值。
sys_startup_fn()：两个 esp_start.c 完全相同；但当前版本缺少 upstream 中声明该函数的 esp_start.h，所以出现隐式声明。

还需确认 Kconfig 插入位置，以及 upstream 如何包含 esp_start.h。执行下面的只读命令：

cd ~/openvela-work/contest284/nuttx

echo "=== 当前 Kconfig 330-430 ==="
sed -n '330,430p' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

echo "=== upstream Kconfig 330-430 ==="
sed -n '330,430p' \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

echo "=== Kconfig 局部差异 ==="
diff -u \
  <(sed -n '320,440p' arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig) \
  <(sed -n '320,440p' ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig) \
  | sed -n '1,260p'

echo "=== esp_start.c 文件头 ==="
sed -n '20,70p' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.c

echo "=== upstream esp_start.c 文件头 ==="
sed -n '20,70p' \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.c

echo "=== esp_start.h 是否存在 ==="
ls -l \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  2>&1

echo "=== 谁包含 esp_start.h ==="
grep -Rns --include='*.c' --include='*.h' --include='Make.defs' \
  'esp_start.h' \
  arch/risc-v/src \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src 2>/dev/null \
  | sed -n '1,100p'

暂时不要直接在 .config 里写：

CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL=0

因为它会在重新配置时丢失。正确做法应是恢复 upstream 的 Kconfig 配置块，让 olddefconfig 自动生成；sys_startup_fn() 也优先恢复 upstream 的正式头文件声明，而不是随手在 .c 中增加声明。

粘贴的文本 (1)(10).txt
文档
思考了 25s

现在可以确认：

esp_start.c 已正确包含 esp_start.h。
当前 esp_start.h 是旧版本，缺少 sys_startup_fn() 声明。
CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL 整个配置块确实没有进入当前 Kconfig。
当前和 upstream 的 Kconfig 排列差异很大，不能直接按 upstream 行号复制，否则可能再次破坏菜单结构。

再做最后一次只读定位：

cd ~/openvela-work/contest284/nuttx

echo "=== esp_start.h 完整差异 ==="
diff -u \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  | sed -n '1,240p'

echo "=== 当前 Kconfig 菜单结构及关键配置 ==="
grep -nE \
  '^menu |^endmenu|^config ESPRESSIF_(SIMPLE_BOOT|BOOTLOADER|CPU_FREQ|MAX_CPU_FREQ|MIN_CPU_FREQ|LOG_LEVEL)' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig \
  | sed -n '1,260p'

echo "=== upstream Kconfig 菜单结构及关键配置 ==="
grep -nE \
  '^menu |^endmenu|^config ESPRESSIF_(SIMPLE_BOOT|BOOTLOADER|CPU_FREQ|MAX_CPU_FREQ|MIN_CPU_FREQ|LOG_LEVEL)' \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig \
  | sed -n '1,260p'

echo "=== 当前 SIMPLE_BOOT 附近 ==="
grep -n -B15 -A30 \
  '^config ESPRESSIF_SIMPLE_BOOT' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

echo "=== 当前第一个外设配置前后 ==="
grep -n -B12 -A12 \
  '^config ESPRESSIF_TWAI0' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

完成这一步后，修复应当是：

从 upstream 精确移植 esp_start.h 中缺少的函数声明；
将官方 Espressif Log Level 配置块插入当前 Kconfig 的正确菜单边界；
执行 make olddefconfig，由 Kconfig 自动生成 CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL=0；
再清理编译。

不会直接硬编码 .config，也不会整份覆盖当前 openvela 的 Kconfig。

粘贴的文本 (1)(20260809-051756).txt
文档
思考了 1m 9s

现在证据充分，可以做两个精确移植：

esp_start.h 与 upstream 只有 SPDX 和 sys_startup_fn() 声明不同，因此可直接同步该头文件。
Log Level 配置块应插在当前 Bootloader and Image Configuration 菜单之前，位置与 upstream 一致。

先同步头文件：

cd ~/openvela-work/contest284/nuttx

cp \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h

再提取并插入 upstream 的官方 Log Level 配置块：

P4_LOG_BLOCK=/tmp/esp32p4_log_level.kconfig

sed -n \
  '/^menu "Espressif Log Level"$/,/^endmenu # Espressif Log Level$/p' \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig \
  > "$P4_LOG_BLOCK"

wc -l "$P4_LOG_BLOCK"

P4_BOOT_LINE=$(grep -n \
  '^menu "Bootloader and Image Configuration"$' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig \
  | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)

echo "Bootloader menu line: $P4_BOOT_LINE"

sed -i \
  "$((P4_BOOT_LINE - 1))r $P4_LOG_BLOCK" \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

确认没有重复插入：

grep -c '^menu "Espressif Log Level"$' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

grep -c '^config ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL$' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

grep -n -B3 -A5 '^config ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL$' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

git diff --check

前两个计数都必须为 1。

然后让 Kconfig 自动生成配置：

make olddefconfig

验证：

grep -E \
  '^CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL(_NONE)?=' \
  .config

grep -E \
  '^#define CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL(_NONE)? ' \
  include/nuttx/config.h

L0 无调试日志配置下，预计得到：

CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL_NONE=y
CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL=0

最后重新构建：

make clean

make -j2 2>&1 \
  | tee ~/openvela-work/logs/contest284_esp32p4_build11.log

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: esp_intr_handler_adapter
 *
 * Description:
 *   This function acts as an adapter to bridge interrupt service routines
 *   between NuttX and the Espressif's interrupt service routine. It is
 *   called when a GPIO interrupt occurs, retrieves the function pointer and
 *   associated data from the 'intr_adapter_from_nuttx' structure passed as
 *   an argument, and invokes the original user-provided interrupt handler
 *   with the IRQ number and user argument.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   arg - Pointer to a structure of type 'intr_adapter_from_nuttx' that
 *         holds the handler function, the associated IRQ, the context, and
 *         the user argument.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   None.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

#ifdef CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_GPIO_IRQ
static void esp_intr_handler_adapter(void *arg)
{
  struct intr_adapter_from_nuttx *adapter;

  adapter = (struct intr_adapter_from_nuttx *)arg;

  adapter->func(adapter->irq, adapter->context, adapter->arg);
}
#endif

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: esp_configgpio
 *
 * Description:
 *   Configure a GPIO pin based on encoded pin attributes.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   pin           - GPIO pin to be configured.
 *   attr          - Attributes to be configured for the selected GPIO pin.
 *                   The following attributes are accepted:
 *                   - Direction (OUTPUT or INPUT)
 *                   - Pull (PULLUP, PULLDOWN or OPENDRAIN)
 *                   - Function (if not provided, assume function GPIO by
 *                     default)
 *                   - Drive strength (if not provided, assume DRIVE_2 by
 *                     default)
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   Zero (OK) on success, or -1 (ERROR) in case of failure.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

int esp_configgpio(int pin, gpio_pinattr_t attr)
{
  DEBUGASSERT(pin >= 0 && pin < SOC_GPIO_PIN_COUNT);

  /* Handle input pins */

  if ((attr & INPUT) != 0)
    {
      gpio_hal_input_enable(&g_gpio_hal, pin);
    }
  else
    {
      gpio_hal_input_disable(&g_gpio_hal, pin);
    }

  if ((attr & OPEN_DRAIN) != 0)
    {
      gpio_hal_od_enable(&g_gpio_hal, pin);
    }
  else
    {
      gpio_hal_od_disable(&g_gpio_hal, pin);
    }

  if ((attr & OUTPUT) != 0)
    {
      gpio_hal_output_enable(&g_gpio_hal, pin);
    }
  else
    {
      gpio_hal_output_disable(&g_gpio_hal, pin);
    }

  if ((attr & PULLUP) != 0)
    {
      gpio_hal_pullup_en(&g_gpio_hal, pin);
    }
  else
    {
      gpio_hal_pullup_dis(&g_gpio_hal, pin);
    }

  if ((attr & PULLDOWN) != 0)
    {
      gpio_hal_pulldown_en(&g_gpio_hal, pin);
    }
  else
    {
      gpio_hal_pulldown_dis(&g_gpio_hal, pin);
    }

  gpio_hal_set_intr_type(&g_gpio_hal, pin,
                         (attr & INTR_TYPE_MASK) >> INTR_TYPE_SHIFT);

  if ((attr & DRIVE_MASK) != 0)
    {
      uint32_t val = ((attr & DRIVE_MASK) >> DRIVE_SHIFT) - 1;
      gpio_hal_set_drive_capability(&g_gpio_hal, pin, val);
    }
  else
    {
      gpio_hal_set_drive_capability(&g_gpio_hal, pin,
                                    GPIO_DRIVE_CAP_DEFAULT);
    }

  if ((attr & FUNCTION_MASK) != 0)
    {
      uint32_t val = ((attr & FUNCTION_MASK) >> FUNCTION_SHIFT) - 1;
      gpio_hal_func_sel(&g_gpio_hal, pin, val);
    }
  else
    {
      gpio_hal_func_sel(&g_gpio_hal, pin, PIN_FUNC_GPIO);
    }

  return OK;
}

/**
 * @brief Connect a peripheral signal which tagged as output attribute with a GPIO.
 *
 * @note There's no limitation on the number of signals that a GPIO can combine with.
 *
 * @param gpio_num GPIO number
 * @param signal_idx Peripheral signal index (tagged as output attribute). Particularly, `SIG_GPIO_OUT_IDX` means disconnect GPIO and other peripherals. Only the GPIO driver can control the output level.
 * @param out_inv True if the signal output needs to be inverted, otherwise False.
 */
static inline void gpio_ll_set_output_signal_matrix_source(gpio_dev_t *hw, uint32_t gpio_num, uint32_t signal_idx, bool out_inv)
{
    hw->func_out_sel_cfg[gpio_num].out_sel = signal_idx;
    hw->func_out_sel_cfg[gpio_num].out_inv_sel = out_inv;
}

/**
 * @brief  Select a function for the pin in the IOMUX
 *
 * @param  hw Peripheral GPIO hardware instance address.
 * @param  gpio_num GPIO number
 * @param  func Function to assign to the pin
 */
__attribute__((always_inline))
static inline void gpio_ll_func_sel(gpio_dev_t *hw, uint8_t gpio_num, uint32_t func)
{
    // Disable USB PHY configuration if pins (24, 25) (26, 27) needs to select an IOMUX function
    // P4 has two internal PHYs connecting to USJ and USB_WRAP(OTG1.1) separately.
    // We only consider the default connection here: PHY0 -> USJ, PHY1 -> USB_OTG
    if (gpio_num == USB_USJ_INT_PHY_DM_GPIO_NUM || gpio_num == USB_USJ_INT_PHY_DP_GPIO_NUM) {
        USB_SERIAL_JTAG.conf0.usb_pad_enable = 0;
    } else if (gpio_num == USB_OTG_INT_PHY_DM_GPIO_NUM || gpio_num == USB_OTG_INT_PHY_DP_GPIO_NUM) {
        USB_WRAP.otg_conf.usb_pad_enable = 0;
    }
    IO_MUX.gpio[gpio_num].mcu_sel = func;
}

arch/risc-v/espressif: Update common-source integration for RISC-V devices
This commit updates the common-source integration for RISC-V-based
Espressif devices (ESP32-C3, ESP32-C6, and ESP32-H2). This is part of a
larger common-source update split by architecture for better maintainability
of the already-supported devices and upcoming devices.

Major components updated:
- IRQ allocator refactoring with intr_alloc integration
- Common-source drivers (GPIO, RMT, I2C, SPI, UART, etc.)
- Espressif components upgrade to release/master.b
- Peripheral drivers (ADC, PWM, LEDC, MCPWM, PCNT, Temperature Sensor, etc.)
- Wireless adapters (Wi-Fi and BLE)
- Board defconfigs for all RISC-V Espressif boards
- Critical section handling improvements

Key architectural changes:
- IRQ Allocator: The new interrupt allocator enables multiple mapping
  options from interrupt sources to CPU interrupts, providing flexibility
  required by modern peripherals. Although this introduces breaking changes
  to the interrupt handling API, the required ARCH_MINIMAL_VECTORTABLE
  Kconfig option is explicitly checked during startup to ensure proper
  configuration. This validation prevents runtime issues from configuration
  mismatches.

Note: This is a large commit to maintain bisectability. Breaking the
changes into smaller commits would result in non-building intermediate
states across the common-source infrastructure update.

Tested configurations:
- All defconfigs were built and tested, inclusing `ostest`.
